title: A palette command
description: What an app declares for the palette (ADR 0414). The data is declarative; the app binds a handler to each id when it registers. How registration happens at runtime is settled with the shell package (UI-B); this is only the shape of one entry.

name.description: What the person reads and types, sentence case; an ellipsis when it opens a dialog

keys.description: A single key or a two-key chord shown beside the name; single-key shortcuts can be turned off or remapped (WCAG 2.1.4)

danger.description: Opens a confirmation; shown with the danger text colour and a word, never colour alone
